quote: Build me a small app that keeps track of everything in my home, with a paid pro version that uses Stripe.

cap: Talk asks before it spends anything.

say: An Opus planner splits the app into parts, and Haiku agents take them, each on its own copy of the code.

quote: Add a dark mode to the app.  ·  Yes.
cap: Mid-build: Talk asks before it sends the request to the agents.

say: The dark mode lands on top of the rest while the other agents work; collisions are redone on the newest code. All nine parts landed in twenty-three minutes, for a dollar seventy-six of model time.
